Results.ReviewText: Very nice grill so far. This is a larger grill than I have had in the past. It will be a nice size when we have family and friends over once the pandemic is over. Grill puts grill marks on whatever you are cooking. Nice touch.
Results.Title: Third Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText: Only used a few times, but so far I believe that you can really believe what the reviews are telling you. Best grill I ever owned.
Results.Title: Quality of Weber Spirit E 310 grill.

Results.ReviewText: i have used charcoal with my old Weber 22" for years. Always liked the way it cooked other than the wait to start grilling. With the new gas grill, it is the same Weber quality, with the convenience of quicker starting times. It does everything from chicken to salmon great!
Results.Title: New to gas, love it!

Results.ReviewText: It was pretty easy to assemble. The instructions were easy to follow. Love the built in gas gauge, and how sturdy it is
Results.Title: Love it

Results.ReviewText: I absolutely love my Weber E-310! Plenty of space, sleek design, and top notch quality. Weber is the only choice, in my opinion, when it comes to grills.
Results.Title: Best choice in grills

Results.ReviewText: Just purchased the grill a couple weeks ago.  My husband and I assembled the grill.  It was difficult attaching the propane tank to the armature due to the weight of the tank (he is 73) but we did it. Will have someone else  change it out for us when empty.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Great functionality.  I like the tank enclosed and out of sight.  I have been cooking on a Weber for 20 plus years and this grill is in keeping with the consistency I have come to appreciate from Weber.
Results.Title: Great functionality and sharp design.

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. Heats up quickly, lots of cooking area.
Results.Title: Weber Spirit E-310

Results.ReviewText: My previous Weber lasted 19 years. Never a question about what I would replace it with.
Results.Title: Long time Grill

Results.ReviewText: I have always purchased  Weber grills because they last and it is so easy to purchase replacement parts.
Results.Title: The very best grill.

Results.ReviewText: It's an amazing grill, the only problem I've found is that it lacks the ability to apply fire fairly directly to the item I'm cooking, resulting in char.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: I love my Weber grill and I have had it several years. I hope they are made in the USA or at least any other country than communist China. That will be a huge impact on the next grill I purchase.
Results.Title: Grill

Results.ReviewText: Easy to start. Even cooking and plenty of room on grills. Well made.
Results.Title: Excellent

Results.ReviewText: While you can expect good performance do not expect good craftsmanship. Also do not expect good Weber to respond to complaints.
Results.Title: Cooking A+, Craftsmanship C, Interaction  D

Results.ReviewText: What can I say, the grill is awesome! It is a pleasure to grill again. The grill heats up evenly and you can control the temperature in the three zones. Starting the grill is a breeze with the push button starter. The best purchase I made all year!
Results.Title: The Best Purchase I Made All Year!

Results.ReviewText: First time Weber owner.  The materials & workmanship of the Spirit E-310 is far superior to other gas grills.  I have had to replace parts annually on my cheaper brands and am looking forward to eliminating this chore.  The built in scale is a great feature and has already saved a dinner from unexpectedly running out of propane.  The one change I would make to the design would be to move the utensil hooks to front of the side shelves rather the ends where they are currently located.
Results.Title: Weber Sprit E-310 - A great value!

ClientResponses.Response: Hello! We are sorry to hear that the bottom panel and the cabinet of your grill have rusted out. We have reached out via email to offer some assistance. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Base of grill and cabinet are completely rusted out. This grill didn’t last as long as it should have for the price I paid.
Results.Title: Rusted out

Results.ReviewText: Great design. Easy to control cooking temperature and easy to clean
Results.Title: Happy with purchase

Results.ReviewText: Our Weber grill is perfect in size.  The quality of the materials the grill is made of is outstanding.  We used the chart that comes with the grill to cook our steaks and they were grilled exactly how we like them.
Results.Title: Happy Weber Griller and Family

Results.ReviewText: It’s awesome. What else can I say. It’s the best grill I’ve ever owned.
Results.Title: I highly recommend this grill.

ClientResponses.Response: Hi! We do not use paint inside our lids. That is just carbonized grease. It's a build up of grease over time. The best way to clean it is by using aluminum foil and scrubbing it. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Disappointed that the paint inside the cover was peeling after 2 years.
Results.Title: Weber paint issues

Results.ReviewText: It is a wonderful grill. My only recommendation is that it would have been nicer if the two side plate holders were able to fold down to save on space.
Results.Title: Weber E-310 Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: Really love this grill! Cooks evenly and efficiently.
Results.Title: Great product!

Results.ReviewText: I love my new Weber Spirit E-310 grill. Grill assembly was easy. Cooks very evenly. Cooking guide 1 page sheet for different foods is very helpful. I only find myself missing 1 feature from my previous grill - I wish it came with a timed gas valve auto-shutoff for burn off cleaning after cooking.
Results.Title: Great gill!

Results.ReviewText: I am very satisfied with this purchase.  It gets very hot quickly as opposed to my other grill.
Results.Title: Great purchase!

Results.ReviewText: This is the first Weber grill I’ve owned, well worth the money.  Quality craftsmanship, fairly easy to assemble.  Have used it several times, heats evenly and I love the cast iron grates.  Design makes it easy to clean after use.  Hope to have this grill for many years to come.
Results.Title: First Weber Ever

Results.ReviewText: Love our new Spirit E-310 gas grill.  We have only ever had Weber and although our old Weber retired, still working and will offer more years of service to whoever grabs it from our "Free" pile!
Results.Title: Weber is King!

Results.ReviewText: Great BBQ - heats up quickly, great burner/heat control
Results.Title: Great BBQ

Results.ReviewText: Great grill for the money! I have been very satisfied.
Results.Title: Awesome Grill

Results.ReviewText: Quality grill, fair price and very even heat.  Have been VERY pleased and we are grilling now more than ever.  Love the gas gauge.
Results.Title: Happy Customer

ClientResponses.Response: Hello, we are sorry to hear your grill started to rust. We certainly would not expect this. We have reached out to you via email to help seek your warranty options on the parts needed. Thank you.
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: I’ve the E-310 for 13 months and it is already showing rust. More importantly, half the time one of the burners doesn’t work. I had a Weber for over 15 years before this one. Quality has gone way down. I will look at other brands.
Results.Title: Disappointed

Results.ReviewText:
Quality product, this is a terrific grill!! Exactly what I would expect from Weber.

Just one thing to note: If you buy a Spirit fully assembled (from a big box store like I did), make sure to check that the grill grates were installed correctly. After grilling a couple times I realized the grill grates were upside down!
Results.Title: Do Some Grilling We Will

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. Thus far it has performed as advertised. Easily moves, easily starts and cleaning the grates aren’t too bad. I like that you can remove the warming rack easily to open up the main cooking surface.
Results.Title: Great grill.

Results.ReviewText: Heats up fast. Great sear. Plenty of grill space for our family of 6.
Results.Title: Weber heats it up!

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
